form.narrative: Hit a stationary truck while reversing in a parking lot. The owner was returning home after collecting a parcel that a friend had delivered to a nearby shop.

photo.description: The car has a moderate dent on the side door.
photo.summary: This image shows a silver car with significant damage to its side, parked on the side of a street. The car's door is crumpled and the paint is scratched. There are several people standing around the car, seemingly observing the damage. In the background, there is a brick wall and some greenery. The scene appears to be in a residential area with a mix of brick and concrete structures. There is a watermark with the text "Za" prominently displayed in the bottom left corner of the image.
